title: The somatic and apical compartments of a layer 5 pyramidal neuron

statements.text: A cortical layer 5 pyramidal neuron has two functionally distinct sites of integration: the somatic compartment at the cell body, fed by the basal dendrites, and the apical compartment near the top of the apical trunk, fed by the tuft dendrites in layer 1.
